r.notes: I was a day visitor,so not sure how often they are seen here. Have seen on numerous occasions when visiting in nearby locations
It had a blue tag in its right ear. Was sitting in the road.  I stopped traffic for it to cross road.
There were two koalas. A large make fighting with a smaller koala. The smaller one was making lots of distress calls and the male was growling.

The koala was very active. I spotted it as it was very far out on a precarious looking limb. It climbed back to the tree, climbed down a strangler (?) vine and jumped over to another tree before reaching the ground and then started to climb back up.
